name: SARM stacking

lead: SARM stacking means using more than one selective androgen receptor modulator at the same time. The appearance goal is more lean mass and less body fat than a single compound is expected to give, in the pursuit of a more muscular physique.

SARMs are investigational drugs designed to activate androgen receptors in muscle and bone with less effect on other tissues. No SARM is approved, and no published trial has tested combinations as a bodybuilding practice.

paras: Forum users discuss combining compounds such as ligandrol (LGD-4033) and andarine (S4), often alongside GW501516, which is not a SARM but is sold as one. These are oral research products sourced online; this wiki does not describe amounts or schedules.

Reported effects include elevated liver enzymes, case reports of drug-induced liver injury, lower HDL cholesterol and suppression of the body's own testosterone. SARMs are banned by WADA and detectable in tests; combinations have not been studied.

chain: More lean mass and less fat
angle.text: Users combine compounds hoping to add muscle and reduce fat more than with one product. No trial has examined combinations for this purpose.

lead: SARM stacking is the use of two or more selective androgen receptor modulators together, usually by people trying to gain muscle and lose fat. The wiki's physique chain is direct: androgen receptor activation in muscle, more lean mass, a more muscular look.[1][2]

SARMs are a drug class built to activate the androgen receptor selectively in tissues like muscle and bone while having less effect on others such as the prostate. First developed in 1998, they are all investigational; none has been approved by the FDA or EMA.[2] Ligandrol (LGD-4033), developed by Ligand Pharmaceuticals, reached Phase II, and andarine (S-4) reached Phase I before discontinuation.[2]

In a looksmax.org thread, a user describes running LGD, S4 and GW together and asks about interactions; replies are dismissive.[1] GW501516 is not a SARM but a PPAR-delta agonist often marketed as one.[2]

paras: Stacking refers to running multiple compounds concurrently. The forum example combines LGD, S4 and GW; the poster says they had used LGD and GW before and were adding S4.[1]
SARMs are orally bioavailable and can act as agonists, antagonists or partial agonists depending on tissue.[2]

In randomised trials, adverse events were generally mild and infrequent, but elevated liver enzymes have been reported, and case reports link recreational use to drug-induced liver injury. HDL cholesterol may fall, and suppression of the HPG axis (lower testosterone, gonadotropins and SHBG) is dose- and compound-dependent. Cardiovascular risk is unknown.[2]
WADA banned SARMs in 2008; athletes in several leagues have tested positive, and they are detectable in urine and hair.[2]

No studies found on stacking. Trials of single SARMs have examined lean mass in patients; the FDA declined approval for enobosarm and others because lean mass gains were not shown to improve physical performance.[2]

lore.intro: Stacks are discussed on looksmax.org in posts asking for advice, with some blunt replies.[1]
